WITH dept_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    ma.department,
    COUNT(*) as dept_count
  FROM income i
  JOIN member m ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id
  JOIN major ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id
  GROUP BY ma.department
),
total_count AS (
  SELECT SUM(dept_count) as total FROM dept_counts
),
dept_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    dc.department,
    dc.dept_count,
    CAST(dc.dept_count AS FLOAT) / tc.total as share
  FROM dept_counts dc
  CROSS JOIN total_count tc
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share
  FROM dept_shares
),
filtered_depts AS (
  SELECT 
    ds.department,
    ds.dept_count,
    ds.share,
    asc.avg_share
  FROM dept_shares ds
  CROSS JOIN avg_share asc
  WHERE ds.share > asc.avg_share
)
SELECT
  SUM(fd.dept_count) as sum_of_counts,
  AVG(fd.share) as avg_of_shares,
  AVG(fd.share - fd.avg_share) as avg_of_diff
FROM filtered_depts fd
